expectation: Membrane stain on follicular dendritic cell networks in lymphoid follicles (dense meshwork in germinal centres) plus mature B-cell rims. It should be uncommon and confined to follicles or lymphoid aggregates, with epithelium and muscle negative.
observed: A: the whole gut wall (mucosa, epithelium, muscularis) is lit about equally, with no follicles picked out. B and D: saturated haze. C: glands and epithelium are stained. E: CD21 shows broad blobs and cell-shaped texture, and CD19 is diffuse haze with no cells.
why: The signal follows tissue density and autofluorescence across every compartment. There are no follicle-confined FDC networks, and CD19 gives no partner structure to check against.
notes: CD21 fills the whole bowel wall, including the epithelium and muscle, and saturates small fields. I could not find any follicular dendritic cell network or B-cell cluster. The CD19 partner is also haze, so row E tells us nothing.
